verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the SDK runs language, speech and vision models on the device, that prompts, audio and images stay local and work with no network, and that the CLI runs local models offline and without an account. Hosted execution is an explicit opt-in that never happens silently. Missing for 10: independent verification of no network egress or telemetry (the 'no data collected' claim appears to come from the project itself), and clear documentation of hardware limits for local inference (e.g. the M3+ requirement for MetalRT).

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: Prompts, audio, and images stay on the phone, and everything keeps working with no network.
When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
A request only leaves your machine _when you say so_.
Hosted and local execution are explicit choices. Wally does not silently move a request between them.
Private by default. Offline by design.
